title: Applications of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) Algorithms for Predicting Scholarly and Citation Impact
content: Scholarly impact, a critical measure of the influence, significance, and contribution of academic endeavors, has traditionally been assessed using rudimentary metrics such as citation counts and peer reviews. While these conventional methods have served as benchmarks, they often fail to encapsulate the intricate and evolving nature of academic influence. Recent breakthroughs in artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) have significantly transformed this domain, enabling the development of more comprehensive, precise, and timely frameworks for assessing scholarly impact. This paper delves into the multifaceted applications of AI and ML in the realm of scholarly evaluation, with a particular focus on citation analysis, alternative metrics (altmetrics), and predictive analytics. Additionally, the paper examines the inherent challenges, ethical considerations, and future directions associated with harnessing these cutting-edge technologies to redefine academic assessment paradigms.
